what_the_eye_sees: Hero at 300 px: a plain, smooth octagonal signet with a spiky crown, or a chess rook or castle turret, stuck on top. About sixteen sharp points ring the top. Two blue ovals show in square-ish slots in its wall, and a small purple square stone sits on a smooth faceted dome. A jeweller would say 'crown ring' or 'castle tower ring'. 'Lantern' only comes up if you are prompted, and 'Gothic cathedral' does not come up at all: the openings read as rectangles rather than pointed arches, the points read as crown spikes rather than crocketed pinnacles, and the band, shoulders and walls are bare polished metal. Face at 300 px: an octagonal nut or bezel with a square purple stone in the middle and dark notches round the rim. It looks like a hex-bolt or a generic cocktail setting. There is no star vault, no ribs and no lancet light; the table reads as a smooth faceted cone. At this size the two views share nothing that says cathedral.
changes: Make the drum's eight openings unmistakable pointed lancets. On each of the 8 drum walls (theta every 45 deg), cut a two-centred pointed arch whose height is at least 2.2 times its width and whose apex is at least 0.6 mm above the springing. Add a 0.8 mm central mullion, or a Y-tracery fork, so each one reads as a Gothic window and not as a slot. Set the stones back at least 0.5 mm behind the arch outline so the metal arch, not the blue oval, is what the eye reads. Acceptance: at 300 px the hero shows at least 3 openings with visibly pointed heads.

Put the star vault on the face, which the spec calls for and the face render does not show. Raise 8 ribs and 8 tiercerons, 0.6 mm wide and 0.45 mm proud, from the boss circle (r 3.7) to the 8 corners and the 8 mid-sides, in place of the smooth faceted cone. Pierce the 8 lancet lights between them as dark pointed shapes, at least 1.1 x 2.4 mm. Acceptance: face-300 shows an 8-point star of ribs radiating from the amethyst, plus 8 pointed dark lights, and no longer reads as a nut or bolt head.

Turn the crown spikes into Gothic pinnacles and carry the building down the ring. Cut the top to the 8 corner pinnacles only (drop or shorten the intermediate spikes by at least 50% so the silhouette stops reading as a crown). Give each pinnacle a visible twist or crocket profile and a knop finial at least 0.6 mm across. Add the specified clasping buttresses with two set-offs on both shoulders (theta about 130 deg and mirrored), and add paired blind lancets on the signet's side walls, cut 0.3 mm. Acceptance: at 300 px the shoulders show a stepped buttress silhouette, the signet walls are no longer blank gold, and a viewer without a caption names it a Gothic tower or lantern.
